links.outcome: Output consistency across duplicate runs of the same prompts
links.effect: Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the most consistent outputs across duplicate runs; consistency differed by model.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro showed highest explanation quality and most consistent outputs, while ChatGPT-4o had shortest response times and highest efficiency.

links.outcome: Accuracy and hallucination rate of LLM extraction of FDA regulatory and trial information
links.effect: Accuracy 66.7% Gemini 2.5 Pro, 51.9% ChatGPT-4o, 37.0% DeepSeek R1 (p<0.001); hallucination was the most frequent error type across models.
links.quote: Hallucination was the most frequent error type across models.

links.outcome: Comparative accuracy across candidate LLMs on the same regulatory extraction task
links.effect: Accuracy differed significantly across models (p<0.001): Gemini 2.5 Pro 66.7%, ChatGPT-4o 51.9%, DeepSeek R1 37.0%.
links.quote: Among 324 responses, accuracy differed significantly across models (χ², p <0.001) with Gemini 2.5 Pro achieving the highest accuracy (66.7%), followed by ChatGPT-4o (51.9%) and DeepSeek R1 (37.0%).

unlisted_practices: Prompt design: general short prompts outperformed detailed guidance-referencing prompts (59.3% vs 44.4%; p=0.011)

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the capability of three LLMs to extract and synthesize clinical trial and FDA regulatory data, comparing performance between general and detailed prompt designs.

primary.practice: prompt engineering strategy (general vs detailed structured prompts)
